title: Social Bias in Popular Question-Answering Benchmarks

bias_targets.methodology: Linking entities mentioned in question-answering benchmark datasets to Wikidata to extract 'gender' properties, then analyzing male-to-female entity ratios and the distribution of occupations by gender.
Querying the Wikidata knowledge graph to retrieve 'religion' properties for dataset entities and calculating the distribution and representation rates of different world religions.

Extracting location-related properties (e.g., coordinates, country of origin, citizenship, and location names) from Wikidata for entities in the benchmarks to analyze regional representation and spatial distributions.
Reviewing benchmark documentation and data examples to catalog the languages supported by the datasets, highlighting the overrepresentation of English.
Retrieving 'occupation' properties from Wikidata for dataset entities to evaluate the most frequent professions and examine stereotypical occupational differences across genders.
